_comment: Exercise registry. Outline exercises are rendered by exercise.html?id=<id>; adding one of Khan's remaining outlines (surahs 85-114) is a JSON entry here, NOT a new page — but the outline text MUST be transcribed from Irfan Ahmad Khan, 'An Exercise in Understanding the Qur'an' (2013), never paraphrased from memory, and must keep sourceIds=khan-exercise-2013. heading/note values are trusted site-authored HTML. The root-spotting entry configures exercise-roots.html; its surah list is safe to extend to any surah since the recurring-root answer key is computed live from data/morphology/.

exercises.title: Coherence reading: Surah al-Asr (103)
exercises.tileDesc: Propose the structure of Surah 103 verse by verse, then compare your reading against the outline in Irfan Ahmad Khan's An Exercise in Understanding the Qur'an (2013).
exercises.provenanceHtml: outline structure from Irfan Ahmad Khan, An Exercise in Understanding the Qur'an: An Outline Study of the Last Thirty Divine Discourses (Surah 85 to Surah 114), Association of Quranic Understanding, 2013. ISBN 9781567447736. Khan's outline for Surah al-Asr is one of thirty surah outlines in the volume; Sources for the full citation.

outline.heading: Verse 1. Oath.
outline.note: Setting the cosmological frame by which the discourse will be measured.

outline.heading: Verse 3. Exception with conditions.
outline.note: Four conjoined qualifications that constitute the exception: faith, righteous deeds, mutual exhortation to truth, mutual exhortation to patience.
